reviews.text:
This is hands down the best vet I have ever visited. The staff was friendly and professional, the place was clean, and they were efficiently taking in patients. I came at my scheduled time and was called in right away. Dr Lee was patient and listened to all my concerns and addressed each one throughly and with care. I’m grateful I found this place.
Prices are very reasonable too!

Dr. Lee and his staff are so wonderful. They are great with both people and the animals. Dr. Lee listens to concerns and trusts the owner’s intuition if something is off. Highly recommend Ivy Veterinary Care.

This is hands down the best vet experience I’ve ever had. When I arrived they immediately brought me into an exam room so my cats wouldn’t haven’t to sit in the waiting area and potentially be frightened by seeing other animals. All of the vet techs, receptionists and the doctor are so incredibly genuine and kind. They walked me through everything they were doing, were gentle with my cats and gave me options on course of care. I never felt pressured to do anything, just armed with the information I need to make choices for my pets. I appreciated that after one of my cats was taken back for ear cleaning and nail trims, they realized she had become too nervous to move forward with x-rays at that time. Instead of making her more uncomfortable, they set me up with medicine I can give her in order to bring her back. You can tell they genuinely care about the animals who come in here. And they don’t price gouge. I compared pricing to what I was paying at my last vet and it was either right the same or lower. It’s SO nice to find a privately owned vet! We will come here forever and I will be referring all my pet owning friends.

First time here but not our first time with Dr. Lee. He’s always very professional and great with my doggie Maxwell. Ivy is very clean, front desk staff and Omar were also very nice, friendly and explained everything well and also asked if I had any questions or concerns. Free parking lot was a plus! I would definitely recommend coming here.
Very helpful and responsive staff and veterinarians. Well-run practice.
Dr. Simpson and staff are incredible. Their facility is spotless, filled with amenities as well.

Dr. Lee is great! He was incredibly thorough, kind, and friendly, and took the time to carefully listen to my concerns and answer all of my questions. It was clear that he genuinely cared about my dogs (Teddy & Ace) needs. We appreciated that he did not pressure us into any unnecessary tests, unlike other veterinarians. He made medical recommendations and was sure to explain the purpose, plan, and expectations of the treatment plan and/or medications. Additionally, the pet examination fees and medication costs are extremely reasonable. The staff is also professional, kind, and very friendly.
We would highly recommend Dr. Lee to other pet owners.

Genuinely we cannot say enough good things about Ivy Vet, Dr.Lee and his team. We brought our sweet kitty here for over a year and a half, and they saw him through with expert care until the end of his life recently. During the process of making this tough decision, they were there with advice, comfort and support and showed our sweet Pirate so much love. And during his normal check ups, he would Honeslty enjoy being in the office and was not nervous at all, they made us all feel so welcome!

Rebecca is truly a light, and was so beyond helpful to us.

They all genuinely truly care about both owners and pets and we couldn't recommend them enough.
Miranda, thanks for the review! Our team appreciates your support.
Everyone at the office was incredibly friendly and professional. Dr. Simpson and Omar were great with cat and made him feel very comfortable!

Ivy Vet is an outstanding Veterinary clinic.  The facility is immaculate and welcoming and Dr. Lee and all the workers are so kind and professional, and it is obvious that they all hold themselves to a very high standard and care deeply for the animals in their care. Dr. Lee helped us navigate the most difficult end of life care for our dog Goose and did it with such compassion.  Would highly recommend, we are so glad to have Ivy in the neighborhood!

Dr Lee and Dr Simpson are the best vets you can find for your furry family members. We’ve been following Dr. Lee for years and are happy to be supporting the practice he owns. Dr. Simpson supported us through our toughest goodbye to our 13 year old boxer with kindness and grace. The knowledge and kindness the whole staff provides are unmatched and we refuse to take our pets anywhere else.
We love this place. The staff was so friendly, helpful and super knowledgeable about my pet. The prices are reasonable. We definitely recommend this place to all pet parents.

Recently switched from another clinic to Ivy. There was high turnover of vets at my previous clinic over a three year period. I wanted to establish care with a single vet given my dog's advanced age.

I can't recommend Ivy enough. Extremely friendly and professional staff at every step; modern scheduling and communication system; Dr Simpson took her time during our visit and answered additional questions via phone/email. Surprise bonus...Ivy was less expensive than our previous corporate vet. Makes me happy knowing Ivy is locally owned by Dr Lee.

Happy to have established care for my dog at Ivy.
Thanks for the 5 stars, Christine! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …

We recently visited this vet and had to make the difficult decision to put our cat down. It was an extremely difficult day for us, but the vet had excellent bedside manner and helped put us at ease and made us feel confident that we were making the right decision.

Dr. Lee has been my pups' vet at three different practices. Where he goes, I follow. He has always taken excellent care of my dogs, who adore him. They actually look forward to going to the vet just to see him.
Thanks so much for the review, Kerry!

Ivy Vet is good and we recommend it.
Everything is always fast and efficient and the care has been good. I would say pricing is on the higher end of some veterinarians but everything is brand new and they built this from the ground up to be efficient for caring for dogs.

The only issue we had is that we were unable to get our city pet friendly area tag, however Dr Lee explained to us that this is a citywide problem and they will keep reaching out to the city to get these tags.  I explained to Dr Lee that we would appreciate it if they continue to put pressure on the city of Chicago to get these tags.

We’ve been living in Chicago for about three years now, and have struggled to find veterinary care for our four pets that didn’t feel like it was breaking the bank or taking advantage of us. Every experience here has been nothing short of amazing and stress free! I’m so sad we didn’t find them till now since we are soon moving but they have been a huge help in getting our pets travel ready ❤️ we love Ivy! Thank you for everything!
-Birdie/Buck/Boone/Betty’s parents :)

Love this independent practice for my senior dog! Dr. Lee is a super nice guy and all the other staff are quite kind, as well. They are so sweet to our pup and she loves going there and getting spoiled with treats.

Love this place!! I switch from my old place because prices kept going up and the service was getting worse. This place is amazing!! So kind and welcoming to my anxious dog! and never tried to upsell me or force me to do things I didn’t want or couldn’t afford. Great care!! Highly recommend. Super clean and calm as well. Beautiful place and excellent staff.

Very, very highly recommended. Dr. Lee was able, without using anesthesia, to obtain and run a much needed urine specimen. (Two other vets had told me my dog would require full anesthesia.) Dr.Lee and his staff are kind, organized and generally quite impressive. This may very well be the best veterinary practice in Chicago.
Always a 5-star experience! The staff goes above and beyond to ensure our dog is comfortable and well cared for.

The folks at Ivy Vet are the best!  From Receptionist to Doctor, I have not found anyone else as genuinely concerned about our Golden Retriever's well being than at  Ivy!
Would give them 10stars if I could.
Very caring and thoughtful clinic. I highly recommend.

Ivy Vet has been such a relief for both me and my anxious Shiba. Dr. Lee and the staff are friendly, welcoming, and very adept at managing solutions during the examination process and general care of my dog. I love it here.

I am so happy I chose Ivy Veterinary Care for my newly adopted kitten Zoe. Dr Kim was so attentive, imformative and welcoming and answered all the questions I had. The receptionist and Vet assistant were amazing as well. Clean and spacious and calming environment. I highly recommend Ivy for everyone!!
Wonderful vet that I would recommend to absolutely everyone!! Our dog is always in great care with them!

This team has taken great care of my cat, who was previously feral and is super scared of everything. I love how communicative they are and how transparent they are about costs as well. It's so nice to have a local community vet I can trust!
Thanks so much for the review, Alisha!
Thanks so much for the review!

We brought in our 2 1/2 year old boy Noctis as we were unhappy with our previous vet. Ivy Veterinary Care was welcoming with a friendly comforting atmosphere. The staff are all so nice and were so good to our boy. Arlene and Dr. Lee were so personable and gave Noctis a thorough exam. Ivy Vet Care and their staff are a breath of fresh air from our previous vet and it's nice to feel seen and feel like your pet is getting the proper type of attention. Keep up the great work!

We love Dr Lee and his team. Exceptional care and service from wonderful techs too. We were with a different vet during a pet urgent situation and couldn’t get in, and randomly called Ivy just to see if they were available. They were remarkably kind and so practically helpful that we moved both dogs over to Ivy and haven’t looked back. My friends take their beloved pets here too.
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Dr. Lee has been very welcoming reassuring and takes the time to listen and answer all of our concerns. Definitely feels like a family vet. Our pup can be very anxious with strangers, but he feels very comfortable with Dr. Lee.
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Great service and staff! My pup was very happy to be there. Thank you for the great service!

I am astonished!  I have a very anxious cat and Dr Lee and team were able to successfully examine him.  It is the first time in a few years he has had an exam due to his bad behavior. In the past other vets have deemed him fractious and required heavy sedation to see him.  We have had several failed vet visits and much trauma (myself and my cat). I had about given up but Dr Lee and his team had a plan. My cat not only cooperated but ate treats from their hands!  They were able to give him vaccines and extract blood.

Even more when we returned home he did not lash out at my other cat. Instead he curled up to her and went to sleep. I am so happy to know that we have finally found the right care for my difficult boy!

I had a great experience at Ivy Vet with Dr. Lee and his team! I recently moved back to Chicago and was in search of a new vet for my bichon/poodle mix. I am so glad to have found Ivy Vet. The reception team could not have been nicer when scheduling, and upon arrival, the staff was very kind, attentive, and curious to learn more about my dog in order to provide him with the best care. The facilities were extremely clean, and the team really takes pride in providing a great service and the location had a parking lot available, as well, which made the logistics so much easier. I will be taking my dog back here for all treatments/shots/etc moving forward, as I trust Dr. Lee's judgment and enjoy working with his team.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

I genuinely cannot say enough good things about our experience. From the moment we walked in, we were welcomed into a beautiful, clean, and calming facility. The entire staff is incredibly kind, patient, and compassionate — you can truly feel how much they care about the animals they treat.

Dr. Lee is phenomenal. After feeling uncertain with our previous vet, he took our concerns about our dogs’ lumps seriously and approached everything with care and thoroughness. He answered every single one of our questions in detail, never made us feel rushed, and explained everything clearly so we felt confident and informed.

The turnaround time has been impressively fast, and they are always responsive when we need clarification or follow-up. It gives us so much peace of mind knowing our fur baby is in such capable and caring hands.

We are so grateful we made the switch. Highly recommend Ivy Veterinary to anyone looking for a vet who truly listens and cares.

WOW and I cannot say wow enough!! From entire staff, the lovely space, and Dr. Lee’s calming, kind and informative presence, we had the BEST experience here. The prices are reasonable and my normally very nervous pom-chi was only a little nervous thanks to the excellent vibes 😅 10/10 will be back!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

The staff is always so kind to both my doggos and we always feel well taken care of. Every time we go everyone is always attentive and knowledgeable; I’m very grateful to have such a great vet in the neighborhood.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Dr. Lee did an incredible job with our dog! He explained all the recommended vaccinations and checks to ensure she’s healthy.

The vet tech did wonderfully working with her as a nervous, reactive dog to ensure she felt safe before assessing her.

We could not be happier to have found this practice! Loving supporting a small business when it seems every vet is owned by private equity. They will not upsell you, and every person who worked there was kind. Our very anxious dog walked out of there more relaxed than we had ever seen him at his previous vet.

Dr. Lee and the team at Ivy Veterinary Care are top notch! My sweet girl doesn't always love the vet, but Dr. Lee and his staff know exactly how to handle her and care for her. They have done wonders for her "Vet Anxiety" and have created a calming and caring environment for my dog. I appreciate all the little details from the layout of the office and their kind and caring approach, as well as how they remember us each visit. I trust Dr. Lee and don't ever feel he is leading me into unnecessary tests/procedures, or not doing enough for my best friend.
I truly love Dr. Lee and the team and I will be a client for life for this dog and any other dogs I may have in the future. Thanks, Ivy Vet Care!

Ivy Vet came highly recommended when I needed a new vet for my anxious pup.  The moment we walked through the door, we were welcomed with warmth.  The staff is so sweet and welcoming. The environment was calming from start to finish.  We didn't wait long at all and our appointment was not rushed at all (one of the reasons I left our previous vet.)  Dr. Lee is kind and patient as my dog is anxious and nervous. He was gentle with her and tried to make her as comfortable as possible.  He didn't force vaccinations that utterly necessary.  Ivy Vet understands that vet visits can be stressful, so they make the visit as easy as possible. I was pleasantly surprised by the pricing as well - even with a full vaccinations update - which is always a bonus! I highly recommend Dr. Lee and Ivy Vet. Fair prices, a calm environment, and a friendly and patient staff - I'm so glad we found Ivy Vet!

Dr. Lee and team are so great with our cats! When our cat was sick, they took the time to give him thorough and thoughtful attention. The team at Ivy is responsive and you can tell they care deeply about each patient who walks through the door!

Lark and I had our very first visit with Dr Lee at Ivy Veterinary last week. Lark and I are both seniors and are so pleased to have Dr Lee and his efficient friendly staff so close by that we can walk to the office. This visit was for Lark's annual check-up where she received a thorough exam, had her vaccines updated, heart worm test and parasite test.  Dr Lee, and his assistant Arlene were both so friendly and caring while examining Lark.  Test results were reported back the next business day.  I am delighted that Ivy Veterinary is not a corporate business and that Dr Lee is the sole owner of this office. I was relieved that Dr Lee did not encourage me to buy into any extraordinary or unnecessary vet services for Lark which had been my experience in the past.  If you are a pet owner  living in the Irving Park area Lark & I highly recommend Ivy Veterinary. You will not be disappointed and it's important that we support our local small businesses!

I take all my dogs to Ivy since we moved to Chicago 6 months ago. We've never had an issue getting scheduled and the office staff are always friendly and helpful. The vet is always happy to see my dogs and answer questions. Everything is always transparent from treatment to pricing.
Dr. Lee and his staff are great with our pet, Pepper. They are extremely knowledgeable and friendly. She really enjoys going there.

Everyone at Ivy Veterinary Care was so friendly, welcoming, and genuinely caring of our pet! They answered questions and concerns I had regarding my pet and shared suggested treatment plans. This is such a difference than the previous vet experiences my pet and I have had. I feel so much more at ease now that I’ve found a vet for my pet that both my pet and I can trust and feel comfortable with. My dog is usually really nervous at vet visits but seemed a lot more at ease with Dr. Lee and the rest of the staff!

Dr. Lee is by far the kindest and thorough Vets I have run across in all my years owning dogs. He explains what is needed. Follows up when he says he will and keeps you informed on all process and results.

The Vet techs at Ivy are truly caring, personable and compassionate. They are a team that goes above and beyond in all they do.

I also recently learned they remember your dogs in and out of office. My dogs and I were walking and bumped into them out of their office one night. They immediately saw my dogs and recoginized them and called them by name. That truly stood out as a team that knows their patients and treats them like one of their own and Finn and Eevee love them so much.

They genuinely care about your pets. Your not a number or a payment. The fees are lower than other vets I have worked with with an abundantly higher level of care.The office is gorgeous, welcoming and clean as a whistle.

Everyone at Ivy makes you feel like you're home. From a recent surgical need to annual check ups and shots, my experience has been nothing short of top-notch.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!

We recently began taking our dogs to Ivy. The office and treatments rooms are beautiful - clean and comfortable - and the staff are all so friendly, welcoming and helpful. Dr Lee is very nice and takes a conservative approach to treatment, which we appreciate. We have one very reactive dog and they are great at managing our experience whenever we come in with her. Overall, very happy to have found Ivy!

Dr. Lee and the entire team at Ivy are exceptional. My cat Dusty is big! And an even bigger baby. He’s shy, sensitive, and easily stressed, so it means the world that they make him feel so safe! From the very beginning, it’s been clear that this team has taken the time to genuinely get to know Dust and all of his little quirks.

They’ve handled some very unpleasant procedures with patience, skill, and so much compassion! They went above and beyond to make sure Dust wasn’t just medically cared for, but happy. They set him up in a spacious condo with his own carrier and litter box, small details that made a huge difference for a nervous cat.

The lobby is also adorable and thoughtfully designed! There's cozy cubicle-esque seating that helps keep waiting calm and stress-free.

I also loved the text updates throughout the visit and their kind follow up and information! I’m incredibly grateful for this team and trust them with my giant baby.
I felt like Dr. Lee was very attentive with my pet's care. Most doctors rush you out to move on to their next appointment. Not the case here. My dog's care was prioritized and reviewed carefully.

Dr. Lee and his team consistently deliver exceptional care. The entire staff is incredibly kind, attentive, and proactive. I’ve brought all three of my four-legged kids here since the clinic opened, and the service has been unwaveringly compassionate and reliable.

The Juarez family would like to give Dr. Lee and the entire Ivy Veterinary Care team a perfect 10/10! They are the best in Chicago. From the moment you walk into the clinic, you’re greeted with warmth and a genuine, welcoming smile. The space is always immaculate, beautiful, modern, and thoughtfully designed. The exam rooms are comfortable, and calming for both pets and humans.
Our four-legged babies Percy and Puss are consistently treated with kindness, patience, and love. As if they were the staff’s own pets. Dr. Lee is exceptionally knowledgeable and always takes the time to explain everything clearly. His compassion and dedication make you feel like family.
We are incredibly grateful and blessed to have found Dr. Lee and his wonderful team. They are all truly amazing people. Thank you Dr. Lee and team there are not words that can describe how grateful we are.🥰🫶🏻💕🙏
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Milo loves coming here. Dr.Lee and his team and professional, also nice and kind. They make sure your little family member will get the best treatment. 💚
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!

Dr. Lee is very kind and professional - he's such a welcomed addition to the Irving Park area. The office is clean and modern; and the staff is professional, friendly & attentive - the bonus is parking right out front! I highly recommend Ivy Pet Care - 10 STARS!
Would highly recommend Ivy.  The staff is extremely friendly and thorough.  They treat your pet like they are their own.
We are grateful for your wonderful review, Ross!

We have really enjoyed our first few visits at Ivy Veterinary Care! They are independently owned which is fantastic. Everyone has been very kind and informative. Our dog has also adjusted really well to them and seems comfortable at the clinic. We have found their prices to be very fair and affordable as well. I would definitely recommend them to a friend!

We loved Ivy . We were welcomed by helpful staffs and our dog felt very at ease and comfortable with Dr Lee. We loved the facility and also liked that Dr Lee brought his own pups to work with him . It is a warm  atmosphere where you feel like Ivy love their clients. Highly recommend for great care of you pets

I couldn't imagine having a better experience with a vet! Everyone is so friendly and our puppy actually LOVES going to the vet. Huge shoutout that any issue we have had with our puppy we will call them and instead of making us come in for an expensive visit, they tell the doctor what's going on and we get recommendations (that have worked 2/2 times) on how to take care of the problem without a visit. And both times this happened they call a day or two later to get an update on how our pup is doing. Have recommended before and could not recommend this vet more! Thank you to all of the employees at Ivy, Juniper loves you all and so do we!
Had a great experience here for the first time with my new shelter pup and looking forward to coming back year over year!

We have a tiny chihuahua mix dog, who is very nervous at the vet, but the staff and Doctor Lee at Ivy Vet are all extremely warm, patient, and kind. The space is clean and inviting. Their pricing is reasonable and fair.
Definitely recommend this is our new vet for our dogs.

All Ivy collective is super friendly and professional.
Highly recommend

I've been a client since Jan 2025 and since then, Dr. Lee and staff have cared for all 3 of my pets. Everything from routine exams, vaccinations, dental cleaning/extractions, urgent care visit, diagnosis of canine renal disease, caring for my cancer cat, Owen and the passing of my sweet cat, Sox. Through it all, they have been so caring and supportive. I am so grateful to have found Dr. Lee who is not only compassionate but knowledgeable and takes the time to talk with, explain and answer questions so patiently. Kori, Rebecca and everyone at the practice are top notch! An added bonus is being able to support a local privately owned practice.

Dr. Lee and the team were very attentive and kind. We appreciated their thoughtful responses to our questions! Our dog is usually afraid of vets and she warmed up to Dr. Lee right away when he walked into the room!
My first time visit with Dr. Lee was very pleasant.  He was kind and patient and was very gentle with my Benjamin. I was they're for his annual exam. I highly recommend Dr. Lee to everyone.

I love having Ivy Veterinary Care in the neighborhood. My dog had an ear infection and I was able to get in quickly for an appointment. Dr. Lee and the team were all very kind and thorough and provided the care and treatment my dog needed.
Lovely office space & nice staff. This is a great addition to the Irving Park neighborhood!

Ivy Vet is top notch, it’s not corporate, and Dr Lee is patient and knowledgeable. The space is inviting to both you and your fur baby. It’s clean and offers coffee and water for you and a toy for your baby. The staff is pleasant and polite to talk to and schedule your services. They actually care about you and your fur baby you’re not just a number here, every fur baby who walks through their door is #1.
Try them out you’ll be glad that you did and most importantly, so will your fur baby.

I’m a new patient at Ivy Veterinary and was so impressed by their responsiveness and kindness. When I adopted my new dog and she quickly became sick, Ivy wasn’t able to see us right away, but they still took the time to answer my questions and guide me toward the emergency vet. That support, even before our formal appointment, made such a difference. Their clear communication and compassion gave me real peace of mind, and I’m grateful for the care they showed us from the very beginning. As a new client, I felt genuinely cared for and respected. I would highly recommend Ivy Veterinary to anyone looking for attentive and supportive care for their pets.

I had a very positive experience with Ivy Veterinary and plan to continue to going here as my dog's primary vet clinic. The customer service was above expectations and Dr. Lee was very professional and friendly. I was very surprised at how affordable the care was compared to the Logan Square-based vet clinic that we had previously been loyal patients of for many years. I am glad that Ivy is in the area and wish Dr. Lee and his staff nothing but success. Thank you for everything.

Dr. Lee and team are amazing.  They are always quick to respond to our questions and concerns.  We had a 13 yr old dog in his final stages and they supported us throughout the process.  Won’t go anywhere else for our dogs.
Dr. Lee & his team provide the highest quality of care. Everyone is so patient, caring& compassionate. We are so thankful we found them!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
We love Ivy Veterinary Care  and Dr. Lee! He has been our vet for 6 years. All staff are kind and professional.

We brought in our dog, Chico, today and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Our dog has anxiety with new people and they gave us tips prior to coming in, and the whole staff were so friendly and understanding to both us and our dog during his shots and exam. Pricing was reasonable too. And the clinic is beautiful. Overall we’re so happy to have a neighborhood place for Chico. Highly recommend!

we love doctor lee and all his stuff!
we have been taking our pets  with them for over a decade now! high quality care and the best team in town .
Welcoming office, caring staff. Dr. Lee was gentle towards my sick cat and didn’t push a barrage of unnecessary treatments. I look forward to working with Ivy as my pet’s vet office.

We had a new pet visit last week.  Everyone was kind and knowledgeable.  I have a calico and she can be spicy.  Dr. Lee took his time to assess her and I really appreciate that.  The hospital is clean and beautiful.
Everyone is so nice & welcoming! Doctor is patient & kind. Thank you all for helping out my Lola!🖤

My pup Yoshi had great care here! Dr. Lee and Arlene were outstanding and made sure my sick pup got the care he needed. I will not go anywhere else but here from now on! (Picture of Yoshi after a great day with them! )

Had to take my 2 dogs in, a Shih Tzu & Maltipoo, for their initial visits, since I'd just changed vets.
Dr. Lee & staff were excellent and thorough.

Would highly recommend  to all other pet parents.
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Sarah, we are grateful for your wonderful review!
Dr.lee took utmost care of both of my shibas! The staff was very welcoming and helpful with setting appointments! Conveniently in old Irving park, it’s a clean, and brand new facility!
Incredibly skilled vet with a high standard of care! I recommend Ivy to all my friends and neighbors!

We love this vet and his friendly and professional staff! They go the extra mile to get us in and address our pets’ needs. We could not be happier with the care they provide and are so grateful that we found Ivy!
Expeditiously delivered excellent care received from this amazing business. They are incredibly skilled and careful with sighthounds. ❤️ Thank you so much!

I take both of my dogs here and they are amazing! Every single person we interact with is so kind and genuinely seems happy to see the patients that come here. During the exam Dr. Lee has always been super patient. We just rescued a little tripod (three legged) girl and he let me take my time asking lots of questions about how to care for her unique needs. Their prices are also the most reasonable I have seen in the Avondale area and they are very transparent about it. I never feel like I’m being pressured for any services for my dogs. Would highly recommend Ivy to everyone!

We're so happy we switched to Ivy Vet at the beginning of this year. Dr. Lee and the entire staff are all so kind, knowledgeable, and thorough. They always check in with us during and after any procedure (e.g., dental cleaning) and follow up to see how our dog is doing at home afterwards. Their facilities are welcoming and very clean, and their prices are also very reasonable compared to other vets in the area. We'll continue to bring our senior pup and any future pets here. Highly recommend!

Came in with Zeno as an emergency patient he was extremely sick and I was so devastated and very emotional the dr and whole team made me feel so comfortable and reassured me constantly I took my baby home which I thought I would not Hope  is what I was given by all staff and especially the Doctor who took time to talk with me patiently when all I was thinking was the worst My baby is home thank you isn’t enough to you all and I appreciate all you have done and will continue to do Thank you

The staff is very accommodating. They frequently fit my cats in for last minute appointments, whenever they can. They know my pets and always inquire about them.  Dr. Lee provides a range of treatment options from conservative to aggressive, but never egregious recommendations. The staff is lovely. They demonstrate a sincere dedication to providing the best care for my cats and I appreciate that.

Stunning office, take both my dogs here. Dr. Lee is so kind and attentive and cares for them just as he would for his own, I trust him with my dogs with my entire heart! Recommend to anyone looking for a new vet. Parking lot too which is a huge plus!!

Dr. Lee and the whole crew (Kori, Rebecca, Arlene) set the standard for what veterinary care should be. I have been to many vets and no one has treated my dogs with the care that the Ivy Vet team has! They are thorough and treat your animals like their own. Dr. Lee helps to inform you about your animals in such a digestible way. I have never felt confused about any care or diagnosis. My Bruno has had to be muzzled at every other vet we have been to, not the case at Ivy Vet! He LOVES seeing Dr Lee and the team.
Outside of Dr. Lee, the rest of the team is phenomenal. It feels like catching up with friends whenever I am at the office! They are so professional and personal at the same time! I know they would recognize my dogs anywhere! Kori is so quick to help with anything she can, whether it is records or just a text asking for some help, I have never felt uncomfortable getting what we need. I am so grateful that Ivy Vet joined our community and set a new standard for veterinary care AND for community! Thank you Ivy Vet!! Bruno and Agnes LOVE YOU!!!

We absolutely love this place, and Dr. Lee and team are so kind to our puppy. Kori is always so welcoming when we arrive and they make it so easy for us! Highly recommend (also easy to get to and parking!).

Dr Lee and the staff were great. Very friendly and welcoming. Listened to my concerns and did great with my reactive and behavioral chihuahua who needs to be muzzled. Very efficient and they were even able to clip his nails!

Cannot recommend Ivy Vet enough!! Rebecca was so wonderful finding an appointment time so seamlessly via email and Kori gave such a warm greeting and knew exactly who Cj was when I arrived! Immediately felt so welcomed and there was a lovely little coffee/beverage bar right in the super cozy lobby! Arlene was so patient and careful with my baby Cj that it was super easy to trust her in their capable hands, she even showed me how to give ear meds [not a fun or easy thing for a kitty!]. The Doctor himself was SO knowledgeable and answered all of my questions with patience and understanding. My girl Cj is on the mend and didn't even have any lasting stress once we got back home. The environment and team is one of a kind, they truly care about your pets health and comfort. Thanks for everything Ivy Vet Team!!!
Everyone here is so friendly and welcoming! You can truly tell they care about the pets they treat, which makes every visit feel comfortable and reassuring.

This was the best experience I have ever had at a veterinary care office. Everyone was so kind and thoughtful, and my cat, who is usually a scared wiggle worm outside of her home, was instantly at ease with the staff and doctor.
